list.title: Patrons
list.countFiltered: {{shown:plural; one:{{shown}} patron matches; other:{{shown}} patrons match;}} the filters
list.removeDescription: For each one, first name and surname, contacts, external id, notes, card number and photo are erased at once and for good; type, class, section and the loan history stay for statistics. Those with open loans are kept.
list.startHint: Search by name, card or with the filters.

fields.emailHint: The address the school gives the student or teacher: it will carry the notices.

errors.cardNumberInvalid: Invalid card number: digits, capital letters and dashes only, with the right check character.
errors.cardNumberTaken: Card number already assigned to another patron.
errors.cardNumberIsCopy: The card number is or looks like a copy barcode: choose another number.
errors.externalIdTaken: Student id already assigned to another patron.
errors.levelRequired: A student needs a class (the level).
errors.levelUnknown: Class not among the levels of the school.
errors.groupUnknown: Section not found among the active classes: classes are created in Administration → Configuration → Classes.
errors.levelNotInGroup: This section has no such class: choose a section of the class.

detail.heading: Patron record
detail.reassignDescription: The current number is retired for good and the new card will need printing.
detail.notesHint: The circulation note pops up at the desk when a loan is made; the other notes stay here.
detail.removeDescription: Erased at once and for good: first name and surname, email, external id, notes, card number (retired) and photo. Only type, class and section and the loan history stay, for statistics. This cannot be undone.
detail.removeOpenLoans: Has {{count}} open {{count:plural; one:loan: it must; other:loans: they must;}} be returned or marked lost first.
detail.removeClassSheets: They were chosen for {{count}} {{count:plural; one:photo; other:photos;}} in the class pictures (census from a picture): {{count:plural; one:that frame is; other:those frames are;}} covered.
detail.removedInfo: Removed on {{when}}. Only the data for statistics remain.
detail.lostHint: Marked lost while on loan to this patron. If they come back, scan them at the returns desk.
detail.markLostDescription: The loan closes and the copy shows as lost. If the book turns up, scan it at the returns desk and it becomes available again.

photo.title: Photo
photo.deleteDescription: The photo is removed from the server; a new one can be taken.
photo.dragHint: Drag to frame, use the zoom to get closer.

errors.too_large: File too large: the limit is {{maxMb}} MB.
errors.not_an_image: The file is not a readable image.
errors.unsupported_format: Unsupported image format (use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC).

photo.withForm: It is saved with the patron.
photo.requiredHint: A photo is expected: take it now, or later from the patron's page.
photo.optionalHint: The photo can be taken now or later from the patron's page.
photo.notSaved: The photo was not saved: take it again from the patron's page.

census.title: Photo census
census.quickAddHint: Added to {{group}}, their photo comes next.
census.pickTarget: Choose a list or a class
census.nothingMissing: Every class and list has its photos.
census.onlyMissing: Only the classes and lists where at least one photo is missing are shown.

sheets.title: From a picture with many photos
sheets.hint: Pictures with several photos (the photographer's sheet, cards on a table, a page of ID photos): the photos are found automatically and assigned to each patron.
sheets.empty: No picture for this class or list.
sheets.counts: {{frames}} {{frames:plural; one:photo; other:photos;}} found · {{saved}} saved · {{pending}} to do
sheets.demoHint: Two ways to get the class's photos: a scan lies flat, its photos are rectangles at most turned; a photo is taken at an angle, the perspective bends the frames.

sheet.title: Photos from a picture
sheet.detecting: Looking for the photos in the picture…
sheet.found: Photos found: {{count}}. Choose whose each one is.
sheet.none: No photo found. With "Correct frames" they can be drawn by hand.
sheet.pictureAlt: The uploaded picture, with the photo frames numbered
sheet.ignored: Ignored: it is nobody of this class or list.
sheet.editHint: Tap a frame and drag its corners; for a missing photo use "Add frame".
sheet.editHintScan: Tap a frame: drag a corner to make it larger or smaller, the circle above it to turn it; for a missing photo use "Add frame".
sheet.addFrameHint: Drag on the picture from one corner of the missing photo to the other.
sheet.kindPhotoHint: Taken at an angle: each corner of a frame moves on its own, to follow the perspective.
sheet.kindScanHint: Made with a scanner: the frames stay rectangles and can only be turned.
sheet.kindAgain: Until a patron is chosen, changing the kind looks for the photos again.
sheet.saveReplaces: They replace the existing photo of: {{names}}.
sheet.saveUnassigned: Frames with nobody chosen: {{count}} (left as they are).
sheet.deleteSheetDescription: The picture and its frames are deleted. The photos already saved stay with the patrons.

errors.set_not_found: The class or the list no longer exists.
errors.too_large: The picture is too large (at most {{maxMb}} MB).
errors.not_an_image: The file is not a readable image.
errors.unsupported_format: Unsupported format: use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.
errors.too_many_frames: At most {{maxFrames}} {{maxFrames:plural; one:photo; other:photos;}} per picture.
errors.bad_corners: The frame is not valid: its corners must make a quadrilateral inside the picture.
errors.already_detected: The photos of this picture have already been looked for.
errors.frame_saved: This photo has already been saved.
errors.frame_erased: This photo belonged to a removed patron: the frame has been covered.
errors.not_a_member: Only the patrons of the class or the list can be chosen.
errors.patron_taken: Already chosen for photo {{position}}: free it before choosing them here.
errors.confirm_replace: {{count:plural; one:{{count}} photo replaces an existing one; other:{{count}} photos replace existing ones;}}: confirm to go on.
errors.nothing_to_save: Choose at least one patron before saving.

sheet.erased: Patron removed: the frame has been covered in the picture.

hints.students: A CSV file with one row per student, separated by ; or , (a spreadsheet export works too). Use the headers of the template, downloaded below with the columns needed.
hints.teachers: A CSV file with one row per teacher, separated by ; or ,. Use the headers of the template, downloaded below with the columns needed.

mapping.uncertain: The format is not certain: check the columns before going on.
mapping.remembered: Columns remembered from the last import of this file.

modes.upsertHint: Rows that match update the existing patron, the others create new patrons.

syncHint.students: The file is the complete list of students: whoever is missing is listed (and removed, after confirmation). Teachers are not touched.
syncHint.teachers: The file is the complete list of teachers: whoever is missing is listed (and removed, after confirmation). Students are not touched.

matchByName.students: Without the external_id column, students on record are recognised by name and class.
matchByName.teachers: Without the external_id column, teachers on record are recognised by name.

preview.ready: No errors: the file can be imported.
preview.blocked: Fix the errors in the file (or in the patrons) and check again: nothing is imported with errors.

students.title: Students on record but missing from the file ({{count}})
students.remove: Remove these students from the records (immediate anonymisation)
students.noPermission: Without the permission to remove patrons, the missing students stay on record.
students.notRemoved: {{count}} missing {{count:plural; one:student; other:students;}} not removed because they have open loans.

teachers.title: Teachers on record but missing from the file ({{count}})
teachers.remove: Remove these teachers from the records (immediate anonymisation)
teachers.noPermission: Without the permission to remove patrons, the missing teachers stay on record.
teachers.notRemoved: {{count}} missing {{count:plural; one:teacher; other:teachers;}} not removed because they have open loans.

missing.hint: With the synchronisation, whoever is not in the file can be removed: personal data are erased at once and for ever, only class and statistics remain.

preview.generatedCards: {{count}} new {{count:plural; one:card; other:cards;}} will be generated: the file has no number.

reasons.tooLong: Text too long in the column {{column}}: at most {{max}} {{max:plural; one:character; other:characters;}}
reasons.cardNumberTaken: Card number already assigned to another patron
reasons.cardNumberIsCopy: Card number equal or similar to a copy barcode
reasons.externalIdTaken: External id already assigned to another patron
reasons.homonym: {{count}} {{count:plural; one:namesake; other:namesakes;}} in the archive: pick which one to update
reasons.matchedTwice: Another row already updates the same patron
reasons.levelUnknown: Year “{{value}}” is not a year of the school
reasons.groupUnknown: Section “{{value}}” not found for this year. Valid classes: {{classes}} (classes are created in Administration → Configuration → Classes)
reasons.levelNotInGroup: Section “{{value}}” has no such year. Valid classes: {{classes}}
reasons.teacherGroupUnknown: Teachers group “{{value}}” not found. Valid groups: {{classes}}

done.title: Import completed
done.printNew: Print the cards of the new patrons
done.batch: Import no. {{id}}: the original file is kept on the server.

class.hint: The class in one column, like 3A or 3 A: it must exist in Administration → Configuration → Classes.

level.hint: The year (1, 2, 3…), with the section in the section column.

section.hint: The section (A, B…): with level it names the class.

cardNumber.hint: The card number, when the student has one already.

externalId.hint: The code of the school register.
externalId.missing: patrons on record are recognised by name and class

group.hint: The teachers group; when missing, the default group.
